```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.height = 4, fig.width = 5, dpi = 150)
```

# 1. Libraries

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
```

# 2. Parameters

```{r params}
data_path <- "F:/wd/deposit_dataset/GSE155096_MetS_microRNA_NGS.txt/GSE155096_MetS_microRNA_NGS.txt"
dir_out   <- "F:/wd/cohort7_miRNAs/external validation/output/01_GSE155096"
dir.create(dir_out, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cat("Input :", data_path, "\n")
cat("Output:", dir_out,   "\n")
```

# 3. Load data

```{r load}
raw <- read.delim(data_path, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE,
                  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# First column = miRNA ID, remaining columns = samples
id_col   <- colnames(raw)[1]
samples  <- colnames(raw)[-1]

cat("Rows (miRNAs) :", nrow(raw), "\n")
cat("Samples       :", length(samples), "\n")
cat("Sample names  :", paste(samples, collapse = ", "), "\n")

print(head(raw))
```

# 4. Summary statistics per sample

```{r summary-stats}
stats_df <- raw %>%
  pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "sample", values_to = "expr") %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(
    n_features = n(),
    n_detected  = sum(expr > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean        = round(mean(expr, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    median      = round(median(expr, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    sd          = round(sd(expr, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    min         = round(min(expr, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    max         = round(max(expr, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    .groups     = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(sample = factor(sample, levels = samples))

print(stats_df)

write.csv(stats_df,
          file.path(dir_out, "sample_summary_stats.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE, quote = TRUE)
cat("Saved: sample_summary_stats.csv\n")
```

# 5. Total counts per sample

```{r total-counts, fig.height=4, fig.width=6}
total_counts <- raw %>%
  summarise(across(-all_of(id_col), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "sample", values_to = "total_counts") %>%
  mutate(
    sample = factor(sample, levels = samples),
    group  = case_when(
      grepl("^C", sample) ~ "Control",
      grepl("^T", sample) ~ "Treatment",
      TRUE                ~ "Other"
    ),
    total_counts_M = round(total_counts / 1e6, 3)
  )

cat("Total counts per sample:\n")
print(total_counts)

write.csv(total_counts,
          file.path(dir_out, "sample_total_counts.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE, quote = TRUE)
cat("Saved: sample_total_counts.csv\n")

p_total <- ggplot(total_counts,
                  aes(x = sample, y = total_counts_M, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65, color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = total_counts_M),
            vjust = -0.4, size = 3.2, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Control" = "#9ecae1",
                               "Treatment" = "#fc9272",
                               "Other"     = "#c7c7c7")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(
    title    = "Total counts per sample",
    subtitle = paste0("Sum of raw counts across all ",
                      nrow(raw), " miRNA features"),
    x        = NULL,
    y        = "Total counts (×10\u2076)",
    fill     = "Group"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle   = element_text(color = "grey40", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank()
  )

print(p_total)

ggsave(file.path(dir_out, "total_counts_per_sample.svg"),
       p_total, width = 6, height = 4)
ggsave(file.path(dir_out, "total_counts_per_sample.png"),
       p_total, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
cat("Saved: total_counts_per_sample.svg / .png\n")
```

# 6. Histograms per sample

Raw expression values are right-skewed; histograms are shown on both raw and
log2(1 + x) scales.

```{r histograms, results='asis', fig.height=4, fig.width=5}
expr_long <- raw %>%
  pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "sample", values_to = "expr") %>%
  mutate(
    sample   = factor(sample, levels = samples),
    log2expr = log2(expr + 1)
  )

for (smp in samples) {

  cat("\n\n## Sample:", smp, "\n\n")

  df_smp <- expr_long %>% filter(sample == smp)

  # ── Raw scale ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  p_raw <- ggplot(df_smp, aes(x = expr)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 60, fill = "#4292c6", color = "white",
                   linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.85) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
    labs(
      title    = paste0(smp, "  —  raw CPM/RPM"),
      subtitle = paste0("n = ", nrow(df_smp),
                        "  |  median = ", median(df_smp$expr, na.rm = TRUE) %>%
                          round(1),
                        "  |  max = ", max(df_smp$expr, na.rm = TRUE) %>%
                          round(1)),
      x = "Expression (raw)", y = "Count"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold"),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 9))

  # ── log2(1+x) scale ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  p_log <- ggplot(df_smp, aes(x = log2expr)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 60, fill = "#41ab5d", color = "white",
                   linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.85) +
    labs(
      title    = paste0(smp, "  —  log2(1 + x)"),
      subtitle = paste0("n = ", nrow(df_smp),
                        "  |  median = ", median(df_smp$log2expr, na.rm = TRUE) %>%
                          round(2),
                        "  |  detected (>0) = ",
                        sum(df_smp$expr > 0, na.rm = TRUE)),
      x = "log2(1 + expression)", y = "Count"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold"),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 9))

  print(p_raw)
  print(p_log)

  # Save SVG
  ggsave(file.path(dir_out, paste0("hist_raw_",  smp, ".svg")),
         p_raw, width = 5, height = 4)
  ggsave(file.path(dir_out, paste0("hist_log2_", smp, ".svg")),
         p_log, width = 5, height = 4)
}
```

# 6. All samples overlay (log2 scale)

```{r overlay, fig.height=5, fig.width=8}
# Identify sample group from name prefix (C = control, T = treatment)
expr_long_grp <- expr_long %>%
  mutate(group = case_when(
    grepl("^C", sample) ~ "Control",
    grepl("^T", sample) ~ "Treatment",
    TRUE                ~ "Other"
  ))

p_overlay <- ggplot(expr_long_grp,
                    aes(x = log2expr, color = sample, linetype = group)) +
  geom_freqpoly(bins = 60, linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.85) +
  labs(
    title    = "All samples — log2(1 + x) expression distribution",
    subtitle = paste0("n features = ", nrow(raw)),
    x        = "log2(1 + expression)",
    y        = "Count",
    color    = "Sample",
    linetype = "Group"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey40", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(p_overlay)

ggsave(file.path(dir_out, "hist_all_samples_overlay.svg"),
       p_overlay, width = 8, height = 5)
ggsave(file.path(dir_out, "hist_all_samples_overlay.png"),
       p_overlay, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
cat("Saved: hist_all_samples_overlay.svg / .png\n")
```

# 7. Boxplot: expression distribution across samples

```{r boxplot, fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
p_box <- ggplot(expr_long %>%
                  mutate(group = case_when(
                    grepl("^C", sample) ~ "Control",
                    grepl("^T", sample) ~ "Treatment",
                    TRUE                ~ "Other"
                  )),
                aes(x = sample, y = log2expr, fill = group)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.8, outlier.alpha = 0.4,
               linewidth = 0.5, width = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Control" = "#9ecae1", "Treatment" = "#fc9272",
                                "Other"   = "#c7c7c7")) +
  labs(
    title = "Per-sample expression distribution  [log2(1 + x)]",
    x     = NULL, y = "log2(1 + expression)", fill = "Group"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(p_box)

ggsave(file.path(dir_out, "boxplot_all_samples.svg"),
       p_box, width = 7, height = 5)
ggsave(file.path(dir_out, "boxplot_all_samples.png"),
       p_box, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
cat("Saved: boxplot_all_samples.svg / .png\n")
```
